test_case.purpose: Prove two same-location CEs cross the rank threshold and create the intended one-bank failed/buddy VLS region with cleared bookkeeping.
required_package: Dedicated SUT, SMM timeout, OOB recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies clean baseline and target, applies mask0x3 and exactly two same-location CEs, proves count0x2/overflow, executes go once, optionally samples copy while active, then verifies durable failed/buddy one-bank region and cleared count/overflow; restores settings and checks health.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly two CEs reach threshold, BIOS SMM creates the mapped one-bank VLS failed/buddy relationship, bookkeeping clears and the system remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/mask, two CEs, pre-go threshold fields, correct durable region/control, cleared bookkeeping and restoration. Wrong geometry, absent/wrong region, uncleared state or instability fails/blocks; missing a transient copy sample alone does not fail.
safety_gate: Critical injection authorization on isolated SUT.

No automatic retry, extra CE, reboot or guessed buddy mapping.

test_case.recovery: On wrong region, failed SMM or hang, preserve all state and use approved OOB recovery without more injection; restore ADDDC/threshold/SMI settings and validate memory topology.
